original_test_intent: Verify that every populated Type 17 record exposes the correct module serial through a valid SMBIOS string reference, maps it to the approved locator/module inventory, satisfies the approved uniqueness/placeholder policy and remains stable after reboot while protecting sensitive identifiers.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17/string-table data in controlled evidence, bind raw serial index/value to locator, manufacturer and part number, validate index/format and approved normalization, compare a trusted inventory/SPD source, compute uniqueness on populated devices, and repeat after reboot using protected hashes plus restricted raw evidence.
manual_activity: A user approves the inventory, privacy/access-control and reboot plan. No DIMM manipulation is required.
required_inputs: Expected serial per populated locator from a trusted source
Allowed normalization and placeholder/blank values by population state
Uniqueness scope and any approved duplicate-placeholder exception
Evidence redaction, hashing, access-control and retention requirements
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/inventory; never write serials or modify memory hardware/firmware.
Validate raw string index/range and retain raw serial only in authorized evidence.
Hashing/redaction must preserve a controlled raw-to-hash audit path; do not publish plaintext unnecessarily.
Check uniqueness only among applicable populated devices and distinguish approved common placeholders from real serial duplication.
Stop on invalid identity mapping, unauthorized evidence handling or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate string reference/format, protected per-locator inventory match and uniqueness, then compare raw-hash/semantic identity after reboot.
Do not expose plaintext broadly, write identity fields, alter modules or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve trusted serial inventory, placeholder/uniqueness rules and evidence-access policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, review restricted mismatches and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The displayed value is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the locator/manufacturer/part context, cannot validate the string index or uniqueness and may expose serials in ordinary logs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete raw Type 17/string data into access-controlled evidence; report locator/population, index validity, protected normalized comparison and stable salted/hash identifier, with plaintext restricted to authorized review.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Serial Number scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing and hardware changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROTECTED PER-LOCATOR SERIAL AND UNIQUENESS VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw string-table references, compare normalized serials to trusted locator inventory in a restricted store, evaluate populated-device uniqueness and use protected digests for general pre/post reports.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 records containing module serial identity.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and trusted inventory/SPD decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Serial Number string-index semantics plus project inventory and data-handling policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string integrity, stable composite identity, trusted source, uniqueness and privacy-preserving evidence handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects invalid/placeholder/duplicate/wrong-slot serials and identity drift without unnecessary plaintext disclosure.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Trusted per-locator serials and privacy/normalization/uniqueness policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS/SPD serials are identifiers, not cryptographic authenticity; unsalted hashes of low-entropy serials may still be sensitive.

project_override_considerations: A project may permit placeholders or duplicate values for empty/unprogrammed devices only when explicitly scoped; evidence protection may change report presentation but cannot omit the controlled raw comparison needed for audit.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module map, trusted serial inventory and normalization/placeholder/uniqueness/privacy policy
Access-controlled complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/string data
Per-locator population/index/format and trusted-inventory result with protected digest map
Duplicate analysis distinguishing real serials from approved placeholders
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot protected identity comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Serial Number is a clear Type 17 string field; privacy and inventory are execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Protected string/inventory and uniqueness checks are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string-reference integrity, trusted locator mapping, uniqueness and sensitive-data controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains privacy/inventory safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines restricted raw evidence versus general digest reporting and keeps verdict engineer-owned.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed serial from passing when it belongs to another socket, is a prohibited placeholder or duplicates a populated module, while avoiding uncontrolled disclosure.
independent_technical_reasoning: String references, normalized identities, hashes and uniqueness are deterministic software checks; approval governs data handling and baseline, not the core automation.
